widget.name: Ruston Next Lead
widget.description: Next-task button for SDRs: sorts the queue automatically and jumps to the next lead in one click. Overdue follow-up tasks cut the line; everything else follows due date.
widget.short_description: Sorted task queue + next lead button.

settings.prioridade: Time-anchored task types that cut the line when due, comma separated. Default: Acompanhar, Reuniao, Diagnostico, ALERTA. Everything else (Ligação, WhatsApp, Email) is cadence, ordered by due date. Matches by substring, accent and case insensitive.
settings.antecedencia: Minutes before the due time a follow-up task jumps the queue (default 5)
settings.position: Button position: bottom-right (default), bottom-left, top-right or top-left
settings.poll_seconds: Queue refresh interval in seconds (min 15, default 45)
settings.atalho: Enable Alt+N keyboard shortcut? Y or N (default Y)
settings.offset: Distance from the edge in pixels, so the button doesn't cover the chat box (default 96)
